6484: Cortech Endurance Crew Armless Chair
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-6484-endurance-armless-crew-chair
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/seating/endurance-crew-armless-chair/
Spec sheets: 6484, Bolt-down kit
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Crew Armless Chair – 6484 / 6484S / 6484KT
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Armless Crew Chair - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 6484
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Armless Chair for Dining Halls and Dayrooms, with Optional Bolt-Down Kit
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 6484 Armless Crew Chair
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Crew Armless Chair is a compact molded chair for dining halls, dayrooms, and group spaces in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The armless profile saves space and makes flexible layouts easy.
The chair is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no metal or wood components and no gaps or fasteners to tamper with. It can stand alone, be weighted at the factory or filled on site with approved material, or be bolted to the floor with the optional bolt-down kit. The Crew Armless Chair is rated for outdoor use.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 22”W×26”D×32”H
Weight: 30 lbs
Weighting: Can be factory weighted or filled on site with approved material; Cortech says not to use loose sand
Floor Mounting: Optional bolt-down kit for bolting to the floor with hardware of your choice
Outdoor Use: Rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
6484 – Standard: 22”W×26”D×32”H, 30 lbs
6484S – With Access Door: Armless chair with an access door
6484KT – With Bolt-Down Kit: Armless chair with the floor bracket for bolting to the floor
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: The optional floor bracket attaches to the chair with tamper-resistant Torx screws, then bolts to the floor with hardware of your choice
Weighting: Factory weighted or filled on site with approved material; do not use loose sand
[H2] Applications
The Crew Armless Chair suits dining and group areas that need safe, durable seating that is easy to rearrange.
Typical applications include:
Dining halls and dayrooms in correctional facilities and jails
Group rooms and dayrooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and other group spaces
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (56 characters): Cortech Endurance Crew Armless Chair - 6484 at Anchortex
Meta description (154 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Crew Armless Chair. A one-piece molded chair for dining halls and dayrooms, rated for outdoor use, with optional bolt-down kit.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
Name: Cortech now calls it the Crew Armless Chair, without "Endurance." I kept "Endurance" as on your current page and in your page address. Would you like it removed?
H1: your current H1 says "Armless Crew Chair." Cortech calls it the "Crew Armless Chair," so I used that. I also took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model," and added the 6484S and 6484KT.
Weight: your variants are set to 24 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 30 lbs, so I used 30 lbs.
6484S (with access door): the current Cortech spec sheet lists only the standard 6484 and the optional bolt-down kit. It does not list a model with an access door. I kept your variant. Can you check that it is still available?
Floor bracket: the Cortech bolt-down drawing shows a 12-gauge floor bracket that attaches to the chair with two 5/16”-18×¾” tamper-resistant Torx flat head screws. I used this in the Installation section.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Antimicrobial: your current page says "infused with CORx antimicrobial compound." The Cortech spec sheet has a "Now infused with antimicrobial compound" badge but does not say more, so I used the ISO 22196 test result only.
GREENGUARD Gold and factory weighting: these come from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet does not mention them.
Outdoor use: the FAQ on the Cortech product page says this chair is rated for outdoor use and UV stabilized, so I added it to the description.
Product images: the page has six images. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
